content: Hello! You're connected with the annual BrightFuture Charity Drive coordination desk. How can I assist you with your donation or verification today?
Hi, I just sent a donation through Zelle and wanted to make sure it was received. It's for the youth scholarship fund.

Of course! Let me check our incoming transactions. Could you confirm the amount and the name or email associated with your Zelle transfer? This helps us match your donation in our records, there's a high volume today.
Sure, the payment was $250, sent from my account using karen.morales84@gmail.com. It should've gone through just now.

Thank you, Karen! I've located a $250 Zelle transfer from karen.morales84@gmail.com received at 2:14 PM with the note 'Youth Scholarship.' For your peace of mind, the confirmation code on our end is ZL20240611-9924. Since these funds will be processed to the scholarship pool by 5 PM, timing is perfect.
Great, can you add my brother's name to the donor acknowledgment? It's Luis Morales, he asked me to include him too.

Absolutely. I've updated the donation record to reflect both Karen Morales and Luis Morales as contributors. Our acknowledgment letters, sent to karen.morales84@gmail.com, will list both names. If you'd like a separate receipt sent to Luis, just let us know his preferred email, no rush, but our thank-you notices go out within 24 hours.
No, that's fine, just send it to me for now. Does everything look good on your side?

Everything is set! Your Zelle payment for $250 from karen.morales84@gmail.com, reference code ZL20240611-9924, is secured for the BrightFuture Youth Scholarship. If you or Luis have any more questions before end-of-day processing, reach us before 5 PM for fastest support.
